Item.Description: Diplomatic goods carried by a commercial carrier.
Military goods carried by a commercial carrier consigned to the Department of National Defense.
Select Orders in Council (OICs) not requiring ATD

Canadian goods refused entry to US, (different from turnarounds) goods are offloaded into warehouse still under US Customs control, and then returned to Canada by same or different carrier through same or different port of entry with or without IE Bond.

Non-commercial (casual goods) entering Canada on a commercial conveyance. For example: Settler/Personal effects, Canadian goods returning, retail merchandise sold to an individual and shipped to Canada.

Goods Astray (Misrouted) - Foreign shipments destined for other points in a foreign country/region, but found astray by the carrier in Canada. Note: Cargo transmitted post-arrival with exception code.
Non-Report - goods arriving in Canada without report to CBSA (verbal, electronic or paper). Note: Cargo transmitted post-arrival with exception code.
Vessels carrying solely Canadian goods that were not discharged at foreign a port but returned to Canada
Emergency stops (only for original shipments that were never intended to arrive in Canada) defined as stops for: Medical, Weather, Mechanical difficulties, Security threats.
Canadian Domestic goods shipped from one point in Canada, found in the United States in error and returned to Canada.
Non-emergency Repairs – Summary Accounting of Vehicle Repairs Program. Note: ATD is required; This code can only be reported on a primary cargo document.
